newsitem.title: GERMANY: Thai Airways says to fly to Munich from Dec 17.
newsitem.headline: Thai Airways says to fly to Munich from Dec 17.

text.p: Thai Airways International Ltd said it will launch a twice-weekly flight from Bangkok to Munich on December 17.
The airline will fly to Munich via Istanbul on Mondays and Thursdays using a DC-10 aircraft, with return flights the following day, a company statement said.

Wallop Bhukkanasut, Frankfurt-based Thai Airways director Germany, Austria and Eastern Europe, said the new flight offered business and leisure travellers from southern Germany more flexible travelling options.
"For shippers in Bavaria, it is an advantage to have a service right on the doorstep," said Guillermo Valencia, cargo sales manager Germany.
Thai Airways would be able to carry 10-12 tonnes of freight per flight, he added. - Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542-7706 Fax+44 171 542-5017
